title: A Heart That Gives
story:
For j-hope, hope has never been only something expressed through music, lyrics, or a smile. It is also something he tries to put into action. Over the years, he has consistently supported people and causes close to his heart, especially children in need of medical care, young people facing financial difficulties, families affected by disasters, and animals in need of protection.

SUPPORTING CHILDREN AND THEIR DREAMS

His charitable work became publicly known in **December 2018**, when he donated **150 million won** to **ChildFund Korea**. The contribution supported children receiving medical treatment and helped young people develop their talents. It was the beginning of a long-standing relationship with the organization and a commitment to helping children who needed support.

In **February 2019**, on his birthday, he donated another **100 million won** through ChildFund Korea. The money was intended to provide scholarships for low-income students at his former high school, **Gwangju International High School**. He had asked the organization to keep the donation private. Later that year, in December, he contributed another **100 million won** to help cover the medical treatment of sick children.

In **August 2020**, as the COVID-19 pandemic caused financial hardship for many families, j-hope donated **100 million won** to support children in crisis, particularly those from families struggling economically. He wanted his contribution to reach children whose lives had become even more difficult because of the pandemic.

His generosity continued in **2021**. On his birthday in February, he donated **150 million won** to support children with visual and hearing impairments. The money helped provide childcare, education, learning opportunities, and support for facilities serving children with disabilities.

In **May 2021**, for Children's Day in South Korea, he donated another **100 million won** through ChildFund Korea to help children in Tanzania who had been exposed to violence. The contribution supported efforts to establish a **One Stop Center**, providing protection and assistance for children affected by abuse and violence. It was a reminder that his concern for children extended far beyond his home country.

At the end of **2021**, he donated a further **100 million won** to help children facing economic hardship during the continuing pandemic. The contribution was intended to cover heating costs for childcare facilities and low-income families, as well as medical expenses for sick children. By that point, his total donations through ChildFund Korea had reached **800 million won**.

HEALTHCARE AND DISASTER RELIEF

In **2022**, j-hope extended his support to healthcare. He donated **100 million won** to **Asan Medical Center** in Seoul, beginning a relationship with the hospital that would continue in the years ahead. The funds were intended to support medical care for children and young patients.

That same year, he also responded to a natural disaster in his home country. In August, following severe rainfall and flooding in central South Korea, he donated **100 million won** to **Hope Bridge Korea Disaster Relief Association** to support emergency relief for people who had lost their homes and livelihoods. Through this contribution, he became a member of Hope Bridge's **Honors Club**, which recognizes major donors.

A HEART FOR ANIMALS

Another act of kindness began quietly in **2022**. After learning about the difficult conditions at the **Imgok Abandoned Dog Shelter** in Busan, where around 50 dogs were living in makeshift kennels offering little protection from the cold, j-hope helped fund the construction of new kennels. His support did not stop there. He has continued to provide dog food whenever the shelter's supplies run low, with his representatives regularly contacting the shelter to check what is needed. The support continued in **2026**, when the shelter once again received food supplies. During his military service, he also sent snacks to veterinarians volunteering to care for abandoned animals.

In **January 2023**, j-hope showed his love for his hometown in another practical way. He contributed **5 million won** to Gwangju's Buk-gu district through South Korea's **Hometown Love Donation Program**. He repeated the contribution in **December 2024**, donating another **5 million won** to support the community where he was born and grew up.

In **February 2023**, he also reached beyond South Korea to help children affected by the devastating earthquakes in Türkiye and Syria. He donated **100 million won** to the **Korean Committee for UNICEF's** emergency relief campaign. The contribution was intended to support children's essential needs, including nutrition, drinking water, hygiene, and protection. He expressed his hope that the donation would bring at least some help to children whose lives had been turned upside down by the disaster.

In **January 2025**, following the tragic Jeju Air plane crash at Muan International Airport, j-hope donated another **100 million won** to Hope Bridge Korea Disaster Relief Association. His contribution was intended to support the bereaved families of the victims. He shared that he had decided to donate after hearing about the accident, hoping to offer the families at least a little help during an unimaginably difficult time.

A BIRTHDAY GIFT THAT KEEPS GIVING

The following month, on his birthday in **February 2025**, he donated **200 million won** to Asan Medical Center's Children's Hospital. This was a continuation of the support he had begun in 2022, and it brought his cumulative donations to the hospital to **300 million won** at that time.

On **February 18, 2026**, j-hope celebrated his birthday by giving back once again. He donated **200 million won** to Asan Medical Center's Children's Hospital and another **100 million won** through ChildFund Korea for scholarships. The scholarships were intended for students at his alma mater, Gwangju International High School, as well as students at Jeonnam Girls' Commercial High School in the same region. He also donated **50 million won** to animal protection organizations, combining proceeds from the **HUMAN HOPE: A JOOPITER Special** charity auction with his own contribution. The funds supported **Animal Rescue 119** and **My Love Baduki With Companion Animals**.

These birthday donations brought his total contributions to Asan Medical Center to **500 million won**. His latest donation to ChildFund Korea also marked a major milestone: with his cumulative contributions to the organization exceeding **one billion won**, he became the **14th member of its Green Noble Trinity Club**, which recognizes donors who have given at least one billion won.

And his support for animals continued beyond the birthday donation. In **November 2026**, the Imgok Abandoned Dog Shelter in Busan publicly thanked him for years of practical help. The shelter confirmed that his representatives continued to send dog food whenever supplies were running low, and recalled how his support had helped provide safer kennels for the dogs back in 2022. His kindness had also inspired fans to organize their own donations for animal welfare, although those contributions were separate from his personal support.

THE MEANING BEHIND HIS GENEROSITY

Perhaps the most touching part of his giving is the reason he has shared for doing it. j-hope has said that he continues to donate because he wants to give something back to ARMY, who have always supported him and shown him so much love. On his birthday in 2026, he expressed his wish that children would be able to overcome their pain and pursue bright dreams, and that everyone would have a hopeful and warm year.

From children receiving medical care to students pursuing their dreams, from families facing disasters to abandoned animals waiting for care, j-hope's generosity has reached many different lives over the years. Some contributions were announced publicly, while others were made quietly and only became known much later.

For j-hope, sharing hope is not just a beautiful idea. It is something he keeps doing, year after year, through real actions that can make a difference in other people's lives.

Because a heart full of hope can also be a heart that gives.
surpriseDescription: His kindness reaches far beyond the stage. Watch this SBS News report about j-hope's continued support for an animal shelter in Busan.

challenge.question: What milestone did j-hope reach with his donations to ChildFund Korea in 2026?
options: He became the 14th member of the Green Noble Trinity Club.
He became the first artist to donate one billion won to Asan Medical Center.
He founded his own international children's hospital.
challenge.answer: He became the 14th member of the Green Noble Trinity Club.
challenge.explanation: With cumulative donations to ChildFund Korea exceeding one billion won, j-hope joined the Green Noble Trinity Club as its 14th member. The organization recognizes supporters whose cumulative contributions reach at least one billion won.
